verdict.rationale: New Relic documents a vulnerability-management agent that triages CVEs, drafts remediation steps, and can open Jira tickets or GitHub issues that trigger a coding agent. Alerts continuously evaluate signals against thresholds and route notifications, so some autonomous background work is documented. However, there is no evidence of a general user-defined automation or workflow builder, and the 'automated remediation' claim is only a marketing line. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable automation/workflow engine, explicit recurring schedules or triggers for custom actions, depth on how the agent runs unattended, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: the agent triages the CVE, provides an analysis, drafts step-by-step remediation recommendations, and can open a Jira ticket or GitHub issue in the affected repository
triggering a coding agent you already use (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or a custom agent) to initiate a fix
